headline: Linn of Mercy Ignites as Weathered Expanse Grinds On
war_summary: Since the morning edition, fighting has reignited fiercely across Linn of Mercy, where five rapid strategic transitions over the past two hours around Outwich Ranch and Lathair have scrambled the sector into two Warden holdings, eight Colonial strongholds, and one ruined no-man's-land. Weathered Expanse continues its desperate maelstrom of counter-assaults, having absorbed eighteen base turnovers in the past six hours as clashes persist near Wightwalk, Crow's Nest, and Spirit Watch. In Kuura Strand, an isolated exchange at Talven cemented full Colonial control over all six regional bases. Farther along the central and western fronts, Callahan's Passage and Nevish Line remain ferocious caldrons of attrition, each reporting over a thousand combined casualties in the last two hours alone, though neither side has managed to shift the fortifications. Meanwhile, sectors that flared earlier—notably Mooring County, Godcrofts, and Stonecradle—have settled into watchful lulls with no fresh base captures reported since the previous wire.
